signal.key_findings: Generated reward per-step mean=0.010 vs original_env_reward=-1.53 — a ~150:1 ratio. The env penalty completely dominates optimization. All 20 eval episodes terminate early (len=68, score=-110.6).
signal.component_anomalies: soft_landing: 0.7% active rate, mean=0.0082/step. Effectively dead gate — fires ~0.5 times per episode yet accounts for 75.5% of episode-sum generated reward (from the rare spikes). progress_gated: 90% active but mean=0.0021, too weak to matter.
signal.training_dynamics: No temporal snapshots available. Final policy shows both components active but at negligible magnitude relative to -1.53 env penalty. The gate structure (angle*vel*angvel floor=0.1) means progress_gated never exceeds 0.001 per step even with perfect behavior.
signal.signal_quality: Main issue is scale mismatch, not gating logic. Even if soft_landing fired every step at max (2.0), it would barely offset the -1.53 env penalty. Generated reward needs ~100x amplitude increase to compete as a learning signal.

args.key_findings: Eval score -110.63, all 20 episodes terminated early (mean len 68.45, all <150 steps with score<-50). Generated reward mean=0.0103/step is drowned by original_env_reward mean=-1.5275/step — a ~1:148 ratio. The agent is failing badly and the shaped reward provides negligible signal.
args.component_anomalies: soft_landing is nearly dead: 0.7% active_rate, fires on <1% of steps. Its episode_sum_mean (0.457) contributes 75.5% of generated reward's signed share, but this is from rare spikes, not steady guidance. progress_gated is active 92% of steps but mean per-step is only 0.0021 — the multiplicative gate (floor 0.001) collapses when posture is poor.
args.training_dynamics: No checkpoint snapshots available for temporal analysis. The final policy shows uniform failure: all 20 eval episodes are early-terminals with scores tightly clustered in [-126.9, -93.3]. No evidence of learning progress or scaffold→final drift.
args.signal_quality: Both shaped components are unreachable in practice: soft_landing requires simultaneous contact+stability (angle<0.5, vel<1.0, angvel<2.0, dist<0.5) which never co-occurs when the agent is failing. progress_gated's multiplicative gate floor (0.1³=0.001) means even max delta_dist yields ~0.001 reward vs -1.5 penalty — no gradient signal survives.
